capabilities: Draw block diagrams with eight shapes, bendable links and grouping frames on an infinite canvas
Link blocks to frames, notes, other drawings or URLs and jump with Ctrl/Cmd+click
Present drawings as full-screen slideshows with speaker notes, timer and animated link flow
Embed drawings in notes via a blockdraw code block or [[Drawing.blockdraw#Frame]] links
Export drawings to Google Sheets, Excel, JSON, SVG and PNG
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Google Sheets secrets are kept per-device instead of in synced settings; web fonts from Google Fonts are off by default.
problem: Obsidian's core Canvas handles freeform cards but not structured block diagrams with shapes, bendable connections, frames, diagrams linked to notes, and presentation mode.

relations.evidence: Exports go through an Apps Script web app that you deploy in your own Google account

requires.name: Google account (Apps Script web app or sign-in)

summary: Block diagram editor that draws titled blocks, links and frames on an infinite canvas and exports to Google Sheets, Excel, JSON, SVG or PNG.
